entities.summary: Carl Ludwig Doleschall was born in Vág-Újhely, Kingdom of Hungary, Austrian Empire, as the son of the theologian Michael Doleschall, and died in Ambon Island, Moluccas, Dutch East Indies only 31 years old. His name is sometimes also written as "Doleschal".
